summary: Request for cryptographically-signed audit batch delivery and retention evidence for compliance review
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (NexGen Health Technologies, enterprise tier) needs a signed delivery of audit logs and a retention/chain-of-custody artifact bundle to satisfy a third-party compliance review (SOC 2 readiness). They require cryptographic proofs that the exported batches were produced by Redwood, have not been tampered with in transit, and include a manifest documenting retention TTL and key IDs used for signing/encryption.

Impact:
Customer cannot complete their external compliance audit without: signed audit batches covering 2025-09-01..2026-02-28, a manifest for each batch, and a short runbook explaining how Redwood signs and stores these artifacts. This is blocking their audit engagement and procurement milestone.

Environment:
Production tenant for NexGen (prod - us-east). Large event volume (avg 120M events/month).

Requested delivery format and properties:
- Delivery: periodic batch (monthly for requested range) as NDJSON files delivered to a pre-signed S3 PUT destination OR an SFTP endpoint (customer will provide).
- Signing: Each file must be accompanied by a detached digital signature (ed25519 preferred) or HMAC-SHA256 with per-batch key. The customer requires: signer key ID, signing algorithm, signature over file digest (SHA-256), and a signed manifest that lists file names + event counts + first/last event timestamps.
- Encryption: AES-256-CBC with envelope encryption using Redwood KMS key; provide KMS key ARN used for envelope.
- Chain-of-custody: A manifest that includes production timestamp, Redwood job-id, sha256 checksums, and a short explanation of when files were immutable and who had access.
- Retention proof: Confirmation that original audit records are retained for 7 years and the retention policy (S3 lifecycle + cold storage) used for this tenant.

Deadline: Customer requested bundle by 2026-03-14 for scheduled auditor review. We are currently past that date; escalate as P1.

Steps to reproduce (how customer triggered request):
1) Customer raised a compliance evidence request to their procurement and was asked for signed audit artifacts.
2) Customer submitted sample event ids via support email (included in comments).
3) Support needs to coordinate with infra/serving runtime to produce verifiable bundles and deliver to the customer endpoint.

Provided sample events/IDs (from customer):
- event_id: 8a9f2c3b-2026-02-14T11:22:33Z
- event_id: b4d0e1f6-2026-01-09T03:12:02Z

Notes: Customer explicitly asked for an auditable signature scheme (they prefer ed25519). If ed25519 cannot be supported in the delivery pipeline within the deadline, provide a documented fallback (HMAC using a per-batch random key) and include key-handling proof.

2026-03-11 Maya Singh (Security): We need to confirm whether infra supports ed25519 signing for bulk exports. If not, HMAC-SHA256 with per-batch random key and KMS-wrapped key is acceptable. Asking infra for feasibility and list of KMS key ARNs used for NexGen tenant.

2026-03-11 Daniel Ortiz (Infra): Infra: We have a PR that adds detached ed25519 signing to the batch pipeline (see PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5123). Staging tests pass for small batches; performance on 100M events/month needs verification. Will run a signing job for the requested months and provide manifests. Linked INT-842 to provision a temporary signing worker pool.

2026-03-12 Ethan Brooks (Support): Customer asked if we can provide a manifest with sha256 checksums, signer key-id, and KMS key ARN. NexGen will provide S3 bucket and IAM role. Asked customer to share bucket ARN and contact for upload troubleshooting.

2026-03-13 Priya Nair (Customer): Sent S3 bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::nexgen-audit-evidence, and an IAM role ARN for uploads. Auditor agreed to accept HMAC fallback if ed25519 isn't ready, but prefers ed25519.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: Security confirmed acceptance criteria for signatures and manifests. ed25519 preferred; fallback HMAC allowed if KMS-wrapped keys provided.

2026-03-11: Infra has initial ed25519 implementation in PR 5123; performance validation in progress. Need to run signing job for 6 months of data and produce manifests. Estimate: 6-8 hours of cluster time for full job at current throughput.
2026-03-12: Provisioned temporary worker pool under INT-842. Preparing job with --detached-signature and --manifest flags. Will upload a single sample month for customer verification before full run.
2026-03-13: Sample batch (2026-02) uploaded to staging S3 and signature verified locally. Waiting on customer validation and production bucket details.
resolution: Pending - sample signed batch prepared and uploaded to staging. Awaiting customer verification of signature format and production S3 IAM role. Final run to produce full 6-month bundle scheduled once customer verifies sample. If customer provides immediate acceptance of HMAC fallback, can accelerate production run and delivery.
